Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of EXECUTIVE OFFICER NAGAR PARISHAD GOGRI JAMALPUR payable at KHAGARIA . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Documents Required 1. The bidder must upload the item list with price as mention in ATC (NITs Item) at the time of b id submission. If the bidder fails to submit the item list along with the bid, the bidder shall be treated as disqualified. 2. Bidder Must be supply as per ATC and SOW. 3. Experience Certificate & Past Performance in Same Organization and Same Product. 4. Proof of Relevant Experience – Supporting documents for eligibility. 5. Copy of PAN Card, GSTIN Certificate Regd. Self-attested, signed & stamped, with GST number clearly. 6. Financial Statements – Copy of Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet or turnover certificat e for the last 3 financial years (CA audited with UDIN). 7. Income Tax Returns (ITR) – Copies for the last 3 financial years. 8. GSTR 3B – Last 6 Months. 9. Copy of Bid Item Related ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, MSME, ZED, CVC GMP. 10. Valid Character Certificate issued by SP. 11. Escalations Matrix Service and Support by OEM and Bidder. 12. Warranty Certificate or declaration on Bidder Letter Head.

13. Local Service and Support Office the Bidder (or its OEM) must have a functional and dedicated Local Service and Support Office located within the Consignee's District. 14. Non-Blacklist Declaration – On ₹1000 non-judicial stamp paper after BID Publish Date, atteste d by Notary. 15. ATC Acceptance Letter – Signed acceptance of Additional Terms & Conditions (mandatory). 16. If any bidder makes complaint against other bidder, then he must submit Rs. 1,00,000 DD in f avour of Executive officer, Nagar Parishad Gogri Jamalpur. Then only complaint will be present ed to procurement committee. If complaints found true then DD will be returned but if complai nt/ allegation found false then DD will be forfeited. After opening of financial bid no complaint will be entertained. 17. No EMD Exemption: Earnest Money Deposit is mandatory (no exemptions allowed for MSME/N SIC etc.). 18. SD Amount 3% Must be deposited in the favour of Executive officer Nagar Parisad Ghogri Jam alpur, Khagaria. . 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
